faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How long does the test take?
faq.answer1: It takes approximately 2 minutes and consists of 12 intuitive questions.
faq.question2: How do I use the results?
faq.answer2: Use it to examine your spending habits and find savings and investment methods that are right for you.
faq.answer3: Rather than directly recommending products, we will provide you with criteria and strategies for selecting products.
faq.question4: Can I share it with my friends?
faq.answer4: Of course. Knowing each other's tendencies makes it easier to manage dating expenses and joint funds.

questions.question: What do you do first when you get paid?

options.a: Transfer a fixed amount to savings account first
options.b: Buy something I wanted right away
options.c: Deposit to investment account and watch for opportunities
options.d: Allocate to living expenses, savings, and investments as planned

options.b: Put it all in emergency fund

questions.question: What do you think about financial management?

options.a: Money is meant to be spent! YOLO
options.b: Safe bank deposits are the best
options.c: Study and invest - money makes money
options.d: Enjoy life, but prepare for the future

questions.question: Daily coffee costs 5,000 won - that's 150,000 won a month!

options.a: Coffee is my happiness! Keep drinking
options.b: Switch to making coffee at home
options.d: Reduce to 2-3 times per week, save the rest

options.a: Enjoy the present moment! Future comes later
options.b: Save at least 100M won for stable life
options.c: Achieve financial freedom! Make money work
options.d: Save moderately while maintaining quality of life

questions.question: What do you think about credit card installments?

options.a: Use often. Can buy without having money now
options.d: Use 0% installments only for large purchases

questions.question: What is your attitude toward financial education?

options.a: Not interested. Rather spend time having fun
options.c: Actively learn via YouTube, books, seminars
options.d: Look up what I need and practice

questions.question: Wedding gift money for a friend?

options.a: 100,000+ won! It's once in a lifetime
options.b: Minimum amount! I am struggling too
options.c: Calculate based on relationship, give exactly

questions.question: What is your plan for owning a home?

options.a: Monthly rent is comfortable. Don't want loans
options.b: Slowly save and buy with cash
options.c: Build seed money through investment, use leverage

questions.question: If you suddenly need a large sum of money?

options.a: Panic! No emergency fund, need to borrow
options.d: Solve by combining emergency fund and liquid assets

spender.title: Start Forced Saving with Auto-Transfer
spender.description: Set up auto-transfer to a savings account on payday to save before you have a chance to spend.
steps: Set up auto-transfer from salary to savings account
Start with 10% of monthly income
Increase to 15% after 3 months, 20% after 6 months
spender.benefit: Achieve savings of at least 15% of annual salary after 1 year

spender.title: Set Spending Priorities
spender.description: Create a 24-hour waiting rule before any non-essential purchase to reduce impulse buying.
steps: Add items to cart and wait 24 hours
Rate necessity (1-10) and satisfaction (1-10)
Only buy if total score is 15+

saver.title: Start with Small Investments
saver.description: Savings alone cannot beat inflation. Start with low-risk investment products to grow your wealth.
steps: Invest 10% of savings in low-risk funds
Start with ETFs or index funds
Increase investment ratio by 5% every 3 months

saver.title: Spending for Quality of Life
saver.description: Excessive frugality lowers quality of life. Invest in experiences and self-reward.
steps: Allocate 5% of monthly budget to experiences/hobbies
Dine out with loved ones quarterly
Secure annual travel budget

investor.title: Secure Emergency Fund
investor.description: Investment assets alone cannot handle sudden expenses. Maintain liquidity for safety.
steps: Keep 6 months of living expenses in an accessible account
Never invest your emergency fund
Replenish immediately after use

investor.title: Strengthen Risk Management
investor.description: Use diversification and stop-loss principles to protect your growing portfolio.
steps: Do not invest more than 10% in one asset
Auto stop-loss at -20% loss
Regularly rebalance your portfolio
investor.benefit: Prevention of major losses and stable returns

balanced.title: Update Financial Knowledge
balanced.description: Maintaining a balanced portfolio requires continuous learning in a changing market.
steps: Watch finance YouTube/podcasts monthly
Review financial status quarterly
Consult an expert annually
balanced.benefit: Stay updated with trends and optimize returns

spender.tip: Reconsider if you still want it after a week
Install coupon apps and check before purchase

saver.tip: Use 5% of monthly budget for self-reward
